title: Practice
overview: This guide covers practice workflows for System Caregiver.

subtasks.title: Practices List (assigned practices)
subtasks.purpose: The Patient Mgmt side-menu for a System Caregiver exposes three lookups: Lookup Patient, Lookup Patient (by RPM date), and Lookup Patient (by CCM date). There is no Add New Patient entry — enrolment is performed by Practice-level roles.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Sign in as a System Caregiver — the workspace lands on Practices List with columns #, Practice Name, Email, Phone 1, Phone 2, Address, Fax, and Action.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Use the All Programs dropdown (top-right) to filter practices by enrolled program (e.g. CCM, RPM), or the Search box to filter by name / email / phone.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Adjust the Show N entries selector and pager (« ‹ Page N of M › ») at the bottom to page through practices when the caregiver is assigned to many.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Click the eye icon in the Action column to open the practice detail view — subsequent Patient Mgmt, Care Mgmt, and Messages actions run in that practice context.
